_design_notes.rack_group_se: south-east, 9 pairs × 25 bays/side × 2 = 450 bays · 200'×120' · south row touches south wall
_design_notes.rack_group_ne: north-east, 3 pairs × 15 bays/side × 2 = 90 bays · 120'×36' · north row touches north wall
_design_notes.floor_grid: Banded N-S: row1 (40') + aisle1 (13') + (row+row 80' + aisle 13') × 4. Numbered AISLE1..AISLE5 run E-W full storage width; stop at racks.
_design_notes.rack_main_aisles: 12' along open edge of each rack group (SE north, NE south); separate from numbered floor aisles
_design_notes.inner_rack_aisles: 6' between rack pairs (8 in SE group, 2 in NE group)
_design_notes.floor_spots: 52 × 40'×40' arranged in 10 N-S rows. Rows truncated where SE/NE rack groups intrude. Row 10 fills empty space above AISLE5 west of NE rack (single row, accessed via AISLE5).
